I was able to layer hop to a layer where [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=3694/sentinel-selarin]Sentinel Selarin[/url] was not there. Once somebody turned in [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=4763/the-blackwood-corrupted]The Blackwood Corrupted[/url], she came running in, spoke her dialogue and offered the quest.
replies: I turned in Escape Through Stealth, which should have made this quest available. It wasn't immediately. I waited around for a minute and checked again, and then the NPC offered the quest. I don't think I did anything to affect it.

comments.body: As of "Classic", Sentinel Selarin is in-game, and offers this quest after one finishes the Volcor escort quests at Terenthis. Ideally, she runs in, talks with Terenthis and soon after their RP is done, she offers anyone eligible this quest (for several minutes). However, if you are eligible, yet she is standing next to Terenthis but not offering any interaction, she is simply bugged and you need a server reset to "fix" her. After this, you may need someone else to finish their quest for her to re-spawn. Also, completing quests in Ashenvale does not remove this breadcrumb quest, so one can still return and do it afterward for the sake of completionism.
replies: Yes, this must be a bug. Someone else had this quest in his/her quest-log and was able to share it with me! So if you can't pick it up yourself for some reason, just ask someone else to share it with you.

I notice there is some confusion as to where Sentinel Selarin is to begin this Quest. I believe she will only appear once you have completed the Quest [A Lost Master] and rescued Volcor and only after you have talked to Terenthis. After turning in the Quest [A Lost Master] to Terenthis, you will notice a short conversation taking place between Terenthis and Sentinel Selarin. After the conversation ends, you will be able to talk to Sentinel Selarin and get the Quest. Hope this helps.
